preregistration_card.question: Does the RK22 5-prime-MFE increment over CAI, CDS GC and CDS GC3 survive fixed-GFP sequence-cluster out-of-distribution evaluation rather than random exact-CDS cross-validation?
preregistration_card.falsifiable_hypothesis: For both ridge and HistGB, adding measured 5-prime MFE improves held-out-cluster Spearman and reduces held-out-cluster MSE relative to the corresponding simple-feature model, with cluster-aware uncertainty excluding zero and positive effects in at least 8 of 10 frozen fold-assignment seeds.
preregistration_card.observed_phenomenon: RK22 random exact-CDS five-fold development analysis found a large positive 5-prime-MFE increment, but it did not test sequence-cluster transport and used all 150 groups in development.
preregistration_card.control_or_comparison: The strong comparator is the identical model trained on CAI, CDS GC and CDS GC3 without MFE. MFE-only models are descriptive references, not substitutes for the incremental comparison. The null is the training-fold mean.
preregistration_card.outcome_metrics: Primary effects are structure-minus-simple global OOF Spearman and simple-minus-structure global OOF MSE for ridge and HistGB, so positive always favors MFE. Absolute OOF metrics and MFE-only performance are secondary descriptions.
preregistration_card.falsification_rule: If any of the four primary effects is non-positive, has a cluster-bootstrap 95% CI including zero, has Holm-adjusted cluster-swap permutation p >= 0.05, or has fewer than 8 positive effects across the 10 fold-assignment seeds, the corresponding family-wide transport claim fails.
preregistration_card.next_decision_rule: A pass supports fixed-protein sequence-cluster transport of the measured-MFE increment and motivates a genuinely independent external validation. It does not by itself authorize generator training because these labels informed RK22 development. A fail removes the claim of robust sequence-cluster transport and keeps RK-G1 closed.

label_free_coverage_audit.pairwise_identity: For two 720-nt CDS strings, the fraction of identical aligned positions; no alignment or label is used.
label_free_coverage_audit.linkage: SciPy complete linkage on condensed distance 1-identity.
label_free_coverage_audit.selection_rule: Choose the lowest candidate identity yielding at least 30 clusters, largest cluster <=75 rows, and singleton clusters <=50% of all clusters.

aggregation.target: Arithmetic mean of log10_expression within exact CDS.
aggregation.features: CAI, gc_cds, gc3_cds and mfe_5prime_kcal_mol must be identical within exact CDS; gc features are recomputed from the 720-nt CDS as in RK22.

outer_evaluation.type: five-fold grouped out-of-fold evaluation on frozen complete-linkage sequence clusters
outer_evaluation.fold_assignment: For each seed, use numpy.random.default_rng(seed) to shuffle the sorted unique cluster IDs; stable-sort the shuffled IDs by descending cluster size. Iterate in that order and assign each whole cluster to one of the currently least-loaded folds. If multiple folds tie for least load, choose among their sorted fold indices with the same RNG. Cluster ID, not expression, determines every assignment.
outer_evaluation.leakage_rule: No sequence cluster may occur in both train and test for any fold. No target or model result may be used for clustering, fold assignment, feature selection or hyperparameter tuning.

models.ridge: StandardScaler fit on training rows only, then Ridge(alpha=1.0).
models.histgb: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=squared_error, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=200, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=10, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=false, random_state=fold_seed).

cluster_bootstrap.procedure: Resample the 37 cluster IDs with replacement, include every exact-CDS row in each selected cluster, and recompute the paired OOF effect. Percentile two-sided 95% CI.

cluster_swap_permutation.procedure: For each permutation draw one sign per sequence cluster and apply it to every row in that cluster; swapping simple and structure predictions within clusters generates the paired null. Recompute each effect and use a two-sided absolute-effect p-value with plus-one correction.

primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm across the four primary tests.
primary_inference.seed_sensitivity_rule: At least 8 of the 10 seed-level global OOF effects must be positive for every primary endpoint. Seed sensitivity is a stability check, not an independent-sample confidence interval.

pass_rule: All four primary endpoints must have observed effect >0, cluster-bootstrap 95% CI entirely above zero, Holm-adjusted cluster-swap p <0.05, and at least 8/10 positive fold-assignment-seed effects.

result_interpretation.not_either: Independent external confirmation, protein OOD, translation velocity, decay, full spatial coupling, RK-G1 completion or generator authorization.
